name: measure-flowcell-comparably
description: Use when FlowCell morphologies, materials, or survivability configurations must be measured on a defensible common basis.
preconditions: calibration set and resource measurement are available or their gaps are explicit
postconditions: synchronized raw evidence and calibration references are preserved
fixture/parasitic losses and uncertainty are reported
replicates, failed runs, anomalies and pre/post inspection remain visible
input-shape: FlowCell scientific/configuration evidence appropriate to the named procedure
output-shape: Typed FlowCell scientific evidence packet described by the postconditions
